document.about: World Bank Macro Poverty Outlook, Spring 2025, South Asia. Each country page draws a poverty chart at its foot whose legend sets each series' sample, a dotted line with the series' marker at its middle, directly before its entry.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#409): the legend repeats at one place on every country page, and its entries were removed as a running foot: International poverty rate kept 5 times of 13, Lower middle-income pov. rate 0 of 7.

2026-11-26 (#409): the chart's source note, Source: World Bank. Notes: See footnotes in table on the next page., is still removed (0 of 7). It is the only template source note scrubbed in the corpus, and is left as a one-layout case.
